record.title: Observe documented physical option baseline
record.intent: Capture actual identity and eleven option status replies without persistent changes.
requirements: Operator authorized the proposed physical read-only baseline. Verify fresh host isolation and start full capture before temporary addressing.
Use only the known specimen private address after a captured valid lease. Maintain only that one lease without gateway or DNS; do not force device network changes.
Connect only to pinned TCP5555 and issue exactly the frozen twelve queries once. Retain raw request and response bytes; stop without retries on any discrepancy.
Seal capture with graceful termination and drop statistics; restore temporary host address and responder state. Preserve baseline and private serial data.
Commit and push redacted result. No installation, capability change, ADB or other device state transition.
acceptance: A verified read-only baseline or exact stop condition is preserved.
